name: Gates of Olympus Super Scatter

features.name: Pay anywhere with tumbles
features.description: Eight to 30 matching symbols anywhere win, and winning symbols are replaced by new ones.

features.name: Super Scatters
features.description: One to four Super Scatters in the trigger pay 100x, 500x, 5,000x or the 50,000x maximum instantly.

features.name: Running multiplier free spins
features.description: In 15 free spins every multiplier on a winning spin adds to a total that stays for the round.

review:
Classic Gates of Olympus – pay anywhere, tumbles, Zeus's multiplier orbs up to 500x – with Super Scatters added.

Four scatters start 15 free spins with a running multiplier total. The new part: Super Scatters in the triggering spin pay instantly – one pays 100x, two 500x, three 5,000x and four the 50,000x max. Same game you know, with a far bigger ceiling (that's very rarely reached).
